name: MIB After Dark
author: Min Kim
description: Omarchy After Dark: eleven screensavers that take over when the machine goes idle. Flying Quattros, Matrix Operator, Omarchy Invaders, Pong Forever, Asteroids, Moon Patrol, Captain Omarchy, Pipes, Starfield, Plasma, and a Terminal Aquarium, with random rotation by category, favorites, per-screensaver options, and optional live system data. Open the control panel with: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.mindows.mib-afterdark
